My First Retexture Mod For Stardew Valley -♡⊹ ࣪ ˖
22 Kawaii Kitty Options For Your Basic Craft-able Scarecrow's!
Choose Between 2 Kitty Poses (Sitting/Sleeping) & 11 Colour Options -♡⊹ ࣪ ˖
Replace Your Vanilla Scarecrow For a Lil Farm Cat To Scare Off Those Pesky Crows /ᐠ-˕-マ 

[img]https://media0.giphy.com/media/v1.Y2lkPTc5MGI3NjExemR4YjQ5Y3FrMG9xODVkdzhwYjF0bXltMjRpazFrNDB6NHJwMXl3YyZlcD12MV9pbnRlcm5hbF9naWZfYnlfaWQmY3Q9Zw/GaMdJiLR4kqh8jJJuz/source.gif[/img]

[size=3]This mod depends on the Alternative Textures framework.
If you don't have the Alternative Textures framework downloaded, or need to update to the latest version, click the following link: 
Alternative Textures: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9246]https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9246[/url]﻿
[/size]
-> Use The Paint Bucket Tool (Which You Can Buy From Robin's Store) Click Your Scarecrow With The Paint Bucket & Select Which Kitty You Want-♡⊹ ࣪ ˖ <-

[size=3][color=#f1f1f1]After you've downloaded the Alternative Textures mod, download this mod and unpack/Unzip It's Contents Into Your Mods Folder Which Should Be Located:

Steamlibrary/Steamapps/Common/Stardew Valley/Mods (If You Use Steam As Your Engine To Play)

If You Don't, Locate Your Stardew Valley Main Folder Within Your Pc And Follow The Steps From (Common). 

[img]https://media2.giphy.com/media/v1.Y2lkPTc5MGI3NjExeHh0cjJmZmszZDcxb3dyeG04Y3ppcXZtdW93cTZ2N3o3NHZkbDI3ciZlcD12MV9pbnRlcm5hbF9naWZfYnlfaWQmY3Q9Zw/v1MTusHoQEI43AUBRW/source.gif[/img]

Which will be an animated version of this mod ♡ So track this mod to keep your eyes out on small updates/refinement as this is my first time modding/using my pixel art in animation :3 Thank You For Reading
